violations.text: Establishment is lacking an allergy statement on their menu. An allergen statement shall be posted on menus and/or shall be made visible to consumers, alerting them to notify staff of any food allergies. i.e. "Before placing your order, please inform your server if a person in your party has a food allergy." New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Soap and paper towel was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen and bathroom. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap and paper towel. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (back), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
2-door cold hold unit located in the (front) area was not in good repair. All equipment shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the (food and surface) sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink). New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Observed establishment lacking an outside receptacle at time of inspection. Per PIC dumpster is in route. Establishment shall have an outdoor storage for refuse, recyclables, and returnables. Receptacles surfaces must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
